statement.ru: Под полосатой шерстью у зебры кожа тоже в полоску.
statement.en: Under its striped coat, a zebra's skin is striped too.

why: False: the coat is striped but a zebra's skin is black.

statement.ru: У жирафа в шее столько же позвонков, сколько у человека.
statement.en: A giraffe has as many neck bones as a human.

why: True: almost all mammals, giraffe and human included, have seven cervical vertebrae.

statement.ru: Кряканье утки не даёт эха.
statement.en: A duck's quack doesn't echo.

why: False: an urban legend, debunked by acoustics researchers in 2003.

statement.ru: Коала — родственница медведей.
statement.en: The koala is a relative of bears.

why: False: the koala is a marsupial whose closest living relatives are wombats; 'koala bear' is a misnomer.

statement.ru: Отпечатки пальцев коалы почти не отличить от человеческих.
statement.en: A koala's fingerprints are almost impossible to tell from a human's.

why: True: even under an electron microscope koala and human prints are hard to tell apart.

statement.ru: Бегемот потеет кровью.
statement.en: A hippo sweats blood.

why: False: the red secretion is a natural sunscreen, neither blood nor sweat.

statement.ru: Собаки потеют языком.
statement.en: Dogs sweat through their tongues.

why: False: dogs cool down by panting; they sweat through their paw pads.

statement.ru: Щенки далматинца рождаются совсем белыми.
statement.en: Dalmatian puppies are born pure white.

why: True: the puppies are born with plain white coats; spots appear within about 10 days.

statement.ru: Кошка мурлычет, только когда ей хорошо.
statement.en: A cat purrs only when it is happy.

why: False: cats also purr when distressed or in pain, for example while giving birth.

statement.ru: Трёхцветная кошка почти всегда — кошка, а не кот.
statement.en: A calico cat is almost always female.

why: True: calico cats are almost exclusively female, for genetic reasons (the colours ride on the X chromosome).

statement.ru: Львы живут в тропических джунглях.
statement.en: Lions live in tropical jungles.

why: False: lions prefer grassy plains and savannahs and rarely enter closed forests.

statement.ru: Если побрить тигра, на коже тоже будут полоски.
statement.en: If you shaved a tiger, its skin would be striped too.

why: True: big cats' skin patterns mirror their fur, so a tiger's skin is striped.

statement.ru: Слон пьёт воду прямо через хобот, как через соломинку.
statement.en: An elephant drinks water straight through its trunk, like a straw.

why: False: the trunk sucks up water and brings it to the mouth; the elephant drinks with its mouth.

statement.ru: У страуса самые большие глаза среди всех сухопутных животных.
statement.en: The ostrich has the largest eyes of any land animal.

why: True: ostrich eyes, about 5 cm across, are the largest of any land vertebrate.

statement.ru: От жабы, если взять её в руки, появляются бородавки.
statement.en: Handling a toad gives you warts.

why: False: a myth; the bumps on toads are glands and human warts are caused by a virus.

statement.ru: Удав убивает добычу, ломая ей кости.
statement.en: A boa kills its prey by breaking its bones.

why: False: a myth; constriction stops the blood flow, it generally doesn't crush bones.

statement.ru: Новокаледонские вороны мастерят крючки из веточек.
statement.en: New Caledonian crows make hooks out of twigs.

why: True: they fashion plant material into hooks to pull grubs out of cracks.

statement.ru: Глотая крупную добычу, змея вывихивает себе челюсть.
statement.en: To swallow big prey, a snake dislocates its jaw.

why: False: snake jaws don't unhinge; the jaw halves are joined by a stretchy ligament.

statement.ru: Попугай какаду может прожить больше 80 лет.
statement.en: A cockatoo can live for more than 80 years.

why: True: Cookie, a pink cockatoo at Brookfield Zoo, lived from 1933 to 2016, 83 years.

statement.ru: Черепаха может вылезти из своего панциря.
statement.en: A turtle can climb out of its shell.

why: False: the shell is part of the skeleton; ribs and spine are fused into it.

statement.ru: Летучие мыши-вампиры отрыгивают кровь голодным соседям.
statement.en: Vampire bats bring up blood to feed hungry neighbours.

why: True: a donor bat regurgitates blood for a colony mate that failed to feed.

statement.ru: У северных оленей рога растут только у самцов.
statement.en: Only male reindeer grow antlers.

why: False: reindeer are the only deer whose females also have antlers.

statement.ru: Лесная лягушка зимой промерзает насквозь, а весной оживает.
statement.en: The wood frog freezes solid in winter and comes back to life in spring.

why: True: wood frogs survive the freezing of their blood and tissues over winter.

statement.ru: Пони — это жеребёнок, детёныш лошади.
statement.en: A pony is a foal, a baby horse.

why: False: a pony is a small breed of horse, fully grown; a baby horse is a foal.

statement.ru: Одна курица прожила без головы полтора года.
statement.en: A chicken lived for a year and a half without a head.

why: True: Mike the Headless Chicken lived 18 months after being beheaded in 1945.

statement.ru: Курица несёт яйца, только если рядом есть петух.
statement.en: A hen lays eggs only if there's a rooster around.

why: False: hens lay with or without a rooster; the eggs are just unfertilised.

statement.ru: Самое быстрое животное на Земле — птица.
statement.en: The fastest animal on Earth is a bird.

why: True: a diving peregrine falcon passes 320 km/h, far faster than a cheetah.

statement.ru: Морская свинка — родственница свиньи.
statement.en: A guinea pig is related to the pig.

why: False: the guinea pig is a rodent from South America, no relation to pigs.

statement.ru: Крысы «хихикают», когда их щекочут.
statement.en: Rats 'giggle' when they are tickled.

why: True: rats are known to 'giggle' (ultrasonic chirps) when tickled.

statement.ru: Лягушка в медленно нагреваемой воде не заметит опасности и сварится.
statement.en: A frog in slowly heated water won't notice the danger and will boil.

why: False: per biologists, a gradually heated frog jumps out; the 'boiling frog' is only a fable.

statement.ru: Ленивец может задержать дыхание под водой на 40 минут.
statement.en: A sloth can hold its breath underwater for 40 minutes.

why: True: by slowing its heart, a sloth can hold its breath for up to 40 minutes.

statement.ru: Мыши больше всего на свете любят сыр.
statement.en: Mice love cheese more than anything.

why: False: mice have no special appetite for cheese; they prefer sweet foods.

statement.ru: Есть ящерица, которая от врагов брызгает кровью из глаз.
statement.en: There is a lizard that squirts blood from its eyes at enemies.

why: True: several horned lizards squirt an aimed stream of blood from their eyes, up to 1.5 m.

statement.ru: Енот полощет еду в воде, потому что у него мало слюны.
statement.en: A raccoon dunks its food in water because it lacks saliva.

why: False: the old saliva idea (Buffon) is now considered incorrect; dousing is about touch and foraging habits.

statement.ru: Язык дятла обвивается вокруг черепа.
statement.en: A woodpecker's tongue wraps around its skull.

why: True: the long tongue bone winds around the outside of the skull, cushioning the brain.

statement.ru: По родству гиена ближе к собакам, чем к кошкам.
statement.en: A hyena is more closely related to dogs than to cats.

why: False: hyenas are feliforms, genetically closer to cats; they only look dog-like.

statement.ru: Птицы-фрегаты умеют спать прямо в полёте.
statement.en: Frigatebirds can sleep while flying.

why: True: a 2016 study with EEG sensors showed great frigatebirds sleep in flight, often one brain half at a time.

statement.ru: У кенгуру сумка есть и у мам, и у пап.
statement.en: Both mother and father kangaroos have a pouch.

why: False: only female kangaroos have a pouch.

statement.ru: Олени каждый год сбрасывают рога и отращивают новые.
statement.en: Deer shed their antlers every year and grow new ones.

why: True: male deer of almost all species grow and shed new antlers each year.

statement.ru: Волки воют на луну.
statement.en: Wolves howl at the Moon.

why: False: wolves do not howl at the Moon; they howl to gather the pack or call each other.

statement.ru: Лошадь умеет спать стоя.
statement.en: A horse can sleep standing up.

why: True: horses can sleep both standing up and lying down.

statement.ru: Если потрогать птенца, родители его бросят.
statement.en: If you touch a baby bird, its parents will abandon it.

why: False: handling eggs or chicks doesn't make the parent birds abandon them.

statement.ru: Козы умеют лазать по деревьям.
statement.en: Goats can climb trees.

why: True: goats are the only ruminants that regularly climb trees.

statement.ru: В природе кролики питаются в основном морковкой.
statement.en: In the wild, rabbits live mainly on carrots.

why: False: wild rabbits eat mostly grasses and clover; the carrot image comes from Bugs Bunny.

statement.ru: Самый большой грызун на свете — капибара.
statement.en: The capybara is the biggest rodent in the world.

why: True: the capybara is the largest living rodent.

statement.ru: Слоны узнают себя в зеркале.
statement.en: Elephants recognise themselves in a mirror.

why: True: elephants show mirror self-recognition, like some apes and dolphins.

statement.ru: Аксолотль может отрастить потерянную лапу.
statement.en: An axolotl can grow back a lost leg.

why: True: axolotls regenerate limbs, gills and even parts of the eyes and brain.

statement.ru: Кролики едят собственный помёт.
statement.en: Rabbits eat their own droppings.

why: True: rabbits re-eat soft droppings (cecotropes) to get the nutrients out of fibre.

statement.ru: Яйцо киви может весить четверть самой птицы.
statement.en: A kiwi's egg can weigh a quarter as much as the bird itself.

why: True: kiwi eggs can weigh up to a quarter of the female's weight.

statement.ru: Большая панда относится к отряду хищных.
statement.en: The giant panda belongs to the order Carnivora.

why: True: the panda is a bear, order Carnivora, though 99% of its diet is bamboo.
